import struct, pathlib
def parse_font(path):
    data=path.read_bytes()
    if len(data)<12: return
    tag=data[:4]
    offs=[]
    if tag==b'ttcf':
        count=struct.unpack('>L',data[8:12])[0]
        offs=list(struct.unpack('>'+str(count)+'L', data[12:12+4*count]))
    else: offs=[0]
    for face,off in enumerate(offs[:5]):
        if off+12>len(data): continue
        sfnt,num=struct.unpack('>LH', data[off:off+6])
        tabs={}
        p=off+12
        for i in range(num):
            if p+16>len(data): break
            t,cs,o,l=struct.unpack('>4sLLL',data[p:p+16]); tabs[t.decode('latin1')]=(o,l); p+=16
        if 'fvar' in tabs:
            o,l=tabs['fvar']; b=data[o:o+l]
            vals=struct.unpack('>LHHHHHH', b[:16]) if len(b)>=16 else None
            if vals:
                version, offset, res, ac, asz, ic, isz=vals
                axes=[]
                q=offset
                for i in range(ac):
                    rec=b[q:q+asz]
                    if len(rec)>=20:
                        tag,minv,defv,maxv,flags,name=struct.unpack('>4slllHH',rec[:20])
                        axes.append((tag.decode('latin1'),minv/65536,defv/65536,maxv/65536,name))
                    q+=asz
                inst=[]
                for i in range(ic):
                    rec=b[q:q+isz]
                    if len(rec)>=4+4*ac:
                        sub,flags=struct.unpack('>HH',rec[:4]); coords=struct.unpack('>'+str(ac)+'l', rec[4:4+4*ac])
                        ps=struct.unpack('>H',rec[4+4*ac:6+4*ac])[0] if isz>=6+4*ac and len(rec)>=6+4*ac else None
                        inst.append((sub, tuple(x/65536 for x in coords), ps))
                    q+=isz
                defs=tuple(a[2] for a in axes)
                print(path.name,'face',face,'tables',list(tabs),'fvar',vals,'axes',axes,'inst',inst,'hasdef',any(i[1]==defs for i in inst),'has gvar', 'gvar'in tabs,'CFF2'in tabs,'CFF'in tabs)
for p in sorted(pathlib.Path('font-corpus').iterdir()):
    try: parse_font(p)
    except Exception as e: print('ERR',p,e)
